div.l: The soth is this . the cut fil to the knyght /
Of whiche ful glad and blith . was eủery wight
And tel he must his tale . as was Reasoun̄
Bi forward . and bi composicioun̄
As ye han herd . what nedith wordis mo
And whan this goode man . saw that it was so
As he that wise was . and obedient
To kepe his forward . and his fre assent
What welcom be cut in goddis name
He saide syn I . shalbe gynne the game
Now late vs Ride . and herken what I say
And with tha word . we Riden furth oure way
And he began . with Right a mirry chiere
His tale anon . and saide as ye may here

l.hi: ¶ Iamque domos patria scithice post aspera gentis prelia laurigero

div.l: Whilom as old stories tellen vs
Ther was a duke · that hight Theseus
Of Athenes he was .· lord and goủernour
And in his tyme · suche a conquerour͗e
That gretter was ther non · vnder the sonne
Ful many a Riche contre · had he wonne
What with his wisdom · and his cheualrie
He conquerid al the Reigne of femynie
That whilom was cleped Scithia
And wedded the faire · qwene Ipolita
And brought hir hom with hym in his cuntre
